keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «침대 밑에 괴물이 있다고 생각한다(처음 생각)» 와 «무서운 괴물은 그냥 우리 고양이였다(반전)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the first thought (I think it is a monster) and the twist (the monster was just my cat). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.qen: What do I think at first?
boxes.a: I think a monster is under my bed.
It is my kitten, Coco, playing with my sock.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

qs.q: Why do I hide under my blanket?
opts: I think a monster is under my bed.
I want to play a game.
evs: Tonight, I want to be brave.
She is playing with my sock.
I take my flashlight and look under the bed.
why: «"It is a monster!" I think.» 괴물이라고 생각해서 무서워 이불 속에 숨어요.
I think it is a monster, so I am scared and I hide.

qs.q: "Tonight, I want to be brave." What does "brave" mean here?
qs.qko: «I want to be brave.» 에서 «brave» 는 무슨 뜻일까요?
opts: not afraid to do something scary
evs: I take my flashlight and look under the bed.
Every night, I hear a noise under my bed.
The scary monster was just my cat!
why: «I take my flashlight and look under the bed.» 무서운데도 침대 밑을 들여다봐요. 그것이 «용감하다»는 뜻이에요.
I look under the bed even when I am scared. That is being brave.

qs.q: What makes the noise under my bed?
qs.qko: 침대 밑에서 나는 소리는 무엇 때문이었나요?
opts: My kitten, Coco, playing with my sock.
A big monster with two eyes.
evs: But it is not a monster. It is my kitten, Coco!
She is playing with my sock.
Two big eyes look back at me!
why: 괴물이 아니라 고양이 코코였고(«But it is not a monster. It is my kitten, Coco!»), 코코가 양말을 가지고 놀고 있었어요(«She is playing with my sock.»). 두 단서를 이어야 소리의 정체를 알 수 있어요.
It is my kitten Coco, and she is playing with my sock. Put the two clues together.

ends: Coco sleeps on my bed every night now.
이제 코코는 매일 밤 내 침대 위에서 잔다.
I hear a new noise in the closet.

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «할 수 없는 일 + 대신 할 수 있는 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you can’t do and what you can do instead in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: 두 칸 모두 «하는 일» 낱말로 시작하게 써 보세요. (예: play soccer, draw a picture)
write.moreEn: One more step: start both blanks with an action word. (e.g. play soccer, draw a picture)
write.src: “I can’t <u>see in the dark</u>, but I can <u>use my flashlight</u>.”
